programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. Aldo Raine assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

programme.title: Death Proof
programme.desc: Stuntman Mike is a professional body double who likes to take unsuspecting women for deadly drives in his free time. He has doctored his car for maximum impact; when Mike purposely causes wrecks, the bodies pile up while he walks away with barely a scratch. The insane Mike may be in over his head, though, when he targets a tough group of female friends, including real-life stuntwoman Zoe Bell (who served as Uma Thurman's double in "Kill Bill"), who plays herself.

programme.title: Northmen: A Viking Saga
programme.desc: Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: Last Knights
programme.desc: A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: A former soldier wages a one-man war against deadly terrorists who hold his niece hostage at a soccer game.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

programme.title: Killing Gunther

programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: CIA agent Bill Pope (Ryan Reynolds) dies while traveling to a secret location to meet a hacker who can launch missiles at will. Desperate to find his whereabouts, officials turn to an experimental neurosurgeon who can transfer memories from one brain to another. The guinea pig for the procedure is Jerico Stewart (Kevin Costner), a violent and dangerous death-row inmate. Now gifted with Pope's skills and knowledge, Stewart must race against time to stop a sinister international conspiracy.

The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Belly
programme.desc: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free.

programme.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
programme.desc: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

programme.title: Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
programme.desc: Judith (Jurnee Smollett-Bell) has known her husband, Brice (Lance Gross), since they were in high school, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy.

programme.title: Fatale
programme.desc: After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he desperately tries to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

programme.title: Addicted

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1

Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2

Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: The Pulse

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1
programme.desc: A fantastical encounter lies at the heart of this documentary: a meeting between the bronze figures of Sanxingdui and the mask of the great Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun. ‘Treasures and Masks’ represents a cutting-edge bridging of ancient Chinese and Egyptian civilizations that has to be seen to be believed.

Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. programme.desc: The Shop has always been about the hustle. For Episode 6, we've got undisputed lightweight champion boxer Devin Haney, rapper Tee Grizzley, actor Amin Joseph, comedian HaHa Davis, marketing executive Paul Rivera, and entrepreneur Maverick Carter. Devin shares how he got put into boxing as a punishment, but wound up being the one doing the punishing, Amin explains how playing Uncle Jerome in Snowfall mirrored the Black experience, Tee Grizzley discusses his start and passion for gaming, and HaHa puts everyone on game about the Detroit mentality. Plus, Devin weighs in on Gervonta Davis' KO over Ryan Garcia. Kick up your feet and remember...in the barbershop, you can't lie.

programme.title: The Shop

Wood recounts starring in cult classic films like Remember The Titans and Above The Rim, as well as working on the LeBron James biopic Shooting Stars, J.B. Smoove explains the unorthodox, yet brilliant, improvisation that makes Curb Your Enthusiasm must-see TV, Shenseea talks creating an entirely new genre within dancehall, and Dominique shares how she was determined to challenge herself as an actress by taking the lead role in Swarm. Kick up your feet and remember...in the barbershop, you can't lie.

programme.title: The Shop
programme.desc: There’s no better outlet that provides knowledge, perspective, and leadership than The Shop. To close out Season 6, 12-time NBA All-Star point guard Chris Paul, rapper & activist Killer Mike, NBA head coach Ty Lue, and actor & producer LaKeith Stanfield join marketing executive Paul Rivera and entrepreneur Maverick Carter. CP3 describes the emotional rollercoaster of publishing his book and the life lessons he learned from his late grandfather, Ty Lue talks what it actually means to be a "player's coach" in the NBA, Killer Mike explains the importance of mentorship to influence the Black community, and LaKeith illustrates why activism today hinges upon being active. Plus, the crew weighs in on Ja Morant and the responsibility they have to inform, educate and lead the next generation. Kick up your feet and remember..in the barbershop, you can't lie.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Dave Arnold's Mom's Stuffing (your new go-to holiday recipe)" - We're excited to share this insane, soon-to-be-family-standard recipe from our good friend, Dave Arnold, who is admittedly is still trying to figure this out from his own mom's recipe. This is THE. ACTUAL. DAVE. ARNOLD. filming himself making the aforementioned famous stuffing with some of our flourishes of text and music. I mean...this is it. Nobody, including Dave Arnold, knows how long to cook it or at what temperature you should cook it at, but we're confident if you're still reading this, you're going to do just fine.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "A THANKSGIVING MIRACLE! David Chang and Friends Make a FULL Thanksgiving Dinner in 2 hours?!?!" - David Chang is joined by Chris Ying and Chris Bianco while they attempt to make an entire Thanksgiving dinner in less than 2 hours...no cuts, no tricks. Just people cooking, cussin', starting things on fire, and having a (mostly) nice time. Hey, it's the holidays...we're all miserable.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "A Truly Incredible Sweet Potato Pie from Malcolm Livingston II" - Acclaimed pastry chef Malcolm Livingston II shares an absolutely INSANE recipe for sweet potato pie that will blow up everything you thought you know about sweet potato pie. You want those sharp edges that could poke an eye out? Of course you do. And the density! Malcolm describes it "like fudge"...or "a perfect caramel that leaves the teethmarks when you bite through it." It's honestly amazing and you don't even have to take our word for it, you can just make it for yourself. Don't be that person that brings some soggy, sloppy pie to your holiday party...watch this video and take notes!

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "David Chang Makes an Epic Thanksgiving Leftover Sandwich" - Dave has joined forces with Amazon Prime Thursday Night Football to create a new tradition for their first-ever Black Friday Football game on November 24—make a ridiculous sandwich for the game MVP using Thanksgiving leftovers. This is Dave's first attempt, so there are plenty of learnings discovered along the way as he tries to construct a worthy sandwich...making an entire Thanksgiving spread along the way. Get ready to unhinge your jaw, because this sandwich is something straight out of Shaggy and Scoob's playbook.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Lisa Donovan's Legendary Pie Crust" - There are pie-makers, and then there's world-renowned pastry chef Lisa Donovan. Lisa blesses the MajordomoTV Studio by taking us step-by-step through her zen-like process of making a perfect, flaky, tender, Southern-style pie crust. The technique! The poetry! The jokes about oversized rolling pins! Lisa is a true master of the pie arts, and if you've ever had ambitions to make your own crust—or just like to zone out watching hands sifting through butter and flour—there's no better place to start than a lesson from Ms. Donovan.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Food markets have a strong tradition in the Netherlands and many citizens count on their long street markets for their fresh food supplies. One of the oldest and most famous markets of the Netherlands is the Albert Cuyp Markt, a street market stretching along the upcoming (and "hip") neighborhood of de Pijp.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty—Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies—Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil’s celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)—served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The Caribbean occupies a special place in the annals of barbecue. Taino Indian barbacoa—seafood and meats smoke-roasted on a wooden platform that gave us the word “barbecue.” The Caribbean remains a hotbed of barbecue delights; Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Trinidadian grilled vegetable dip called Choka and Shrimp Boka Dushi—a spicy Dutch West Indian kebab whose name literally means “happy mouth.”

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Texas BBQ to many means brisket, but in this show, you’ll experience the Texas Trinity: Grilled Quail with Pear Salsa and Blue Cheese Farroto prepared by San Antonio master chef Jason Dady. Smoked and Grilled Rib-Eye Steaks accompanied by Smashed Potatoes. And a sizzling sandwich, a Hot Gut Hero (beef sausage with pepper Jack cheese). It’s the Texas Trinity hot off the grill.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Across Latin America, grilling styles vary: Argentine and Uruguayan masters embrace simplicity, seasoning steaks with just salt. In contrast, Mexican chefs layer bold flavors—marinating meats in recados and adobos, wrapping them in aromatic leaves, and searing over hardwood fires. Here are three spectacular Mexican grilling specialties that showcase this rich, fiery tradition.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: San Antonio is the home base for this season of Planet Barbecue. One of only two cities in the U.S. designated a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, the Alamo City boasts a cuisine as colorful as its historic city center. Get ready for Carne Asado Breakfast Tacos, Jason Dady’s Oak-Smoked Cherry-Glazed Ribs, and Beef Cheek Barbacoa prepared by local smoke master Esaul Ramos.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: When Columbus landed in what is now the Bahamas in 1492, he initiated an East-West culinary exchange that continues to this day. This show explores three European grill classics—each with a New World twist. From Wood-Grilled Gazpacho with Serrano Ham Crisps to a unique Pearl District Spiessbraten served with Jicama Salad. And for dessert? Spectacular Smoked, Torched Creme Brulée.

programme.title: Serial Griller
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with “Hot Handhelds,” grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.desc: Jenna muss wieder auf den Pfad der Tugend zurückkehren. Doch sie hat ihren Freunden und ihrer Familie mehr Schaden zugefügt, als sie so schnell wiedergutmachen kann. Werden sie ihr verzeihen, oder muss sie extremere Mittel einsetzen?

programme.desc: Da sein 16. Geburtstag immer näher rückt, fragt RJ seinen Vater nach Fahrstunden und bekommt weit mehr als das: Rick nimmt ihn mit in einen Strip Club.

programme.title: Sex. Teen. Candles
programme.desc: RJ und seine Freunde wollen einen "Max Bash" für Max Owens Geburtstag veranstalten. Als Max und seine Gang auf der Party aufkreuzen geraten die Dinge außer Kontrolle.

programme.title: Es knistert zwsichen Jeannine und Jerry I Tag 18 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Die "Normalen" bekommen ihre neue Wochenaufgabe: sie müssen Altkleider waschen, trocknen, bügeln und in Papier einschlagen. Es zieht außerdemnoch eine neue Bewohnerin in den Bereich der "Survivor" ein: Jennifer. Kay beklagt sich wieder über sein Leben bei den "Normalen". Die "Reichen" müssen heute gegen die "Survivor" antreten. Beim "Mauer-Match" müssen die Teams eine Mauer bauen und wer diese zuerst hochgezogen hat, gewinnt. Es folgt ein zweites Match, bei dem die beiden Teams gegeneinander antreten müssen. Jedes Team muss eine Person auswählen, die 24 Stunden lang Sand in ihrer Hand behalten muss. Die Person, die nach 24 Stunden am wenigsten von dem Sand verloren hat, gewinnt. Jerry holt sich Tipps von Kader, um bei den Frauen zu punkten. Sie verrät ihm, was er sagen muss, um einer Frau zu schmeicheln. Ihre Tipps scheinen sehr hilfreich gewesen zu sein, denn bereits am Abend kommen sich er und Jeannine näher und es fallen sogar Küsse.

programme.title: Kay verlässt freiwillig das Haus I Tag 19 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Kay hat sich dazu entschlossen, das Big Brother-Haus zu verlassen. Er begründet seine Entscheidung damit, dass er im Haus zu wenig Spaß habe und sich mit dem Leben bei den "Normalen" nicht identifizieren könne. Endlich sind die 24 Stunden vorbei und der Sand wird gewogen. Der "Survivor" Ali hat mehr Sand in der Hand behalten können, womit sein Team gewonnen hat. Als Belohnung bekommen die "Survivor" ein Festmahl serviert im Bereich der "Reichen" serviert. Jennnifer ist erst seit einem Tag bei den "Survivorn", doch sie hat bereits jetzt mit dem dortigen Leben zu kämpfen. Sie vertraut sich Ramona an. Ramona fällt das Leben im Big Brother-Haus auch nicht leicht, denn sie hat Heimweh und vermisst ihre Mutter, denn ihr kann sie sich anvertrauen.

programme.title: Jeannine und Jerry werden intim miteinander I Tag 20 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Bei dem heutigen Match heißt es: rühren, rühren, rühren! Die Kandidat:innen aus dem Team "Normal" und aus dem Team "Reich" treten gegeneinander an müssen flüssiges Eiweiß rühren, sodass es steif wird. Das Match ging unentschieden aus, weswegen die Team-Kapitäne eine knifflige Frage beantworten müssen. Das Team "Normal" hat gewonnen und darf für einige Tage die Vorzüge des "reichen" Bereiches genießen. Die "Normalen" befinden sich nun im "reichen" Bereich. Achim wird als Dienstmädchen geholt, was für die "Normalen" eine ganz besondere Genugtuung ist. Auch Kader muss zum ersten Mal ran an den Staubwedel und an den Besen. Jerry hat ein Problem mit Jeannine's Freizügigkeit. Er ist der Meinung, dass jeder sich über sie lustig gemacht habe, als sie nackt im Pool war. In einem Gespräch mit Mark betitelt Jerry ihr Verhalten soagar als "billig". Doch später geht es noch heiß her zwischen den beiden und sie werden intim miteinander.

programme.title: Wechseln die "Survivor" den Bereich? I Tag 21 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Das Team "Normal" hat die letzten Wochen hart gearbeitet und bekommt jetzt eine Entschädigung. Da es sich jetzt im "reichen" Bereich befindet, darf es nun eine Massage genießen. Kader ist heute im Sprechzimmer zu ehrlich wie noch nie und äußert ihre Meinung zu Sascha. In ihren Augen ist er nicht authentisch und zieht im Big Brother-Haus eine Masche ab. Nachdem sich Jeannine und Jerry gestern näher gekommen sind, will er heute von ihr wissen, ob sie eine treue Person ist. Mark führt das selbe Gespräch mit Franzi. Heute steht ein Wechsel-Match an. Die "Survivor" spielen gegen die "Normalen". Die "Survivor" haben wieder verloren und müssen somit in ihrem Bereich bleiben. Franzi hat heute die Gelegenheit, das Big Brother-Haus für eine kurze Zeit zu verlassen. Sie hat sich einen Einkaufsbummel bestellt. Von Big Brother hat sie dafür 1500€ bekommen, die sie komplett auf den Kopf haut. Jeannine, Jerry und Mark unterhalten sich am Essenstisch über Sex im Big Brother-Haus. Jerry stellt im Sprechzimmer klar, dass er nichts ernstes von Jeannine will und dass sie nicht sein Typ ist.

programme.title: Die "Survivior" dürfen in den "reichen" Bereich I Tag 22 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Big Brother ist heute gnädig und lässt die "Survivor" in den "reichen" Bereich, damit sie sich aufwärmen können. Anschließend verwöhnt Mark Jennifer mit einer Massage. Dabei lästert sie über ihr Teammitglied Lisa, Jeannine muss sich heute einem Lügendetektortest unterziehen. Dabei gesteht sie, dass sie Jerry sehr gern mag und sich was mit ihm vorstellen könnte. Die "Survivor" treten heute gegen die "Normalen" beim Marshmallow-Wettbewerb an. Franzisak gewinnt das Match für ihr Team. Michael will seinen Posten als Team-Kapitän abgeben, um seine Mitbewohner:innen zum Nachdenken anzuregen. Kader will von ihren Mitbewohnern wissen, wie sie sich ihre Traumfrau vorstellen. Die Antworten der Männer kann man kaum ernst nehmen.

programme.title: Mark und Sascha über einen traurigen Schicksalsschlag I Tag 23 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Mark und Sascha haben einen traurige Gemeinsamkeit. Beide haben bereits ihren Vater verloren. Sie unterhalten sich draußen über die traurigen Schicksalsschläge. Jennifer lästert am Zaun mit Mark wieder über ihre Teamkolleg:innen. Franco und Sascha wollten sich einen Basketballkorb bauen. Dafür schnitt Franco die Gardinenschnur durch. Das lässt Big Brother nicht durchgehen und bestraft ihn gemeinsam mit Achim, der sein Mikro wiederholt nicht trug. Als Strafe werden sie aneinandergefesselt. Die "Reichen" und die "Normalen" müssen heute wieder in ihre ursprünglichen Bereiche zurück. Michael wird von den "Reichen" bestellt. Lisa hat vor der nächsten Woche Angst. Die Kandidat:innen müssen sich dann nämlich gegenseitig für den Auszug nominieren. Sie glaubt, dass sie ganz oben auf der Liste der Bewohner:innen steht.

programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss erkunden die gefährlichen Everglades und wollen sich den Alligatoren und Schlangen stellen! So zumindest der Plan. Anfangs ist weit und breit nichts zu sehen, doch plötzlich sind sie von allen Seiten umzingelt! (S4 E11)

programme.desc: Carmen Geiss' Geburtstagswochenende nimmt nochmal richtig Fahrt auf! Nächste Aktivität: venezianische Masken bemalen. Während Carmen Geiss ganz filigran den Pinsel schwingt, ist Ehemann Robert Geiss nach einem kompletten Anstrich schon fertig – typisch! (S4 E15)

programme.title: Typisch Geissens! Action statt Entspannung in
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht einen Wochenendtrip nach Saint-Tropez! Carmen Geiss freut sich auf ein entspanntes Wochenende, aber daraus wird wohl nichts. Ehemann Robert Geiss hat andere Pläne: Ein Boot ist organisiert, und es geht direkt aufs Wasser! (S5 E01)

programme.desc: In Bodrum gönnen sich Robert und Carmen Geiss eine wohlverdiente Auszeit. Ein riesiges Luxus-Boot darf dabei natürlich nicht fehlen. Doch die Erholung währt nicht lange – Robert hat sich verletzt! (S5 E08)

programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss nehmen auf Monacos Bootmesse alles genau unter die Lupe. Auf dem Wasser soll dann die Post abgehen! Doch dabei stört die Kamera! Also wird diese, samt Kamerateam, einfach vom Boot verwiesen. (S5 E11)

programme.title: Nervenzusammenbruch? Ein Horrortrip für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Es wird richtig wild! Die Geissens besuchen Seaworld in Orlando und Carmen Geiss muss mit Tochter Davina auf die Achterbahn. Diese entpuppt sich für Carmen als echter Horrortrip... (S5 E13)

programme.title: Robert Geiss lässt seine Frau einfach stehen?!
programme.desc: Shania Geiss' Geburtstagsparty steht an. Carmen Geiss wechselt schnell in den Designerfummel. Doch kaum ist sie fertig, düst Robert einfach los und lässt sie stehen! (S5 E13)

programme.title: Völlig benebelt in Malaysia?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet Kuala Lumpur – natürlich stilecht mit Luxus-Guide Albert. Der gebürtige Malaysier hat einiges geplant: Der erste Stopp ist ein chinesischer Tempel, wo Carmen und Davina Geiss einen geheimnisvollen Zukunftszettel ziehen. (S5 E14)

programme.title: Tempelhöhle wird zur Mutprobe!
programme.desc: Tourguide Albert hat sich für die Geissens in Kuala Lumpur etwas Besonderes überlegt: die Tempelhöhle! 👀 Doch um dort hinzugelangen, muss die Familie 272 Treppenstufen erklimmen. Carmen Geiss mit Klaustrophobie und Robert Geiss mit Höhenangst.. (S5 E15)

programme.title: Affen-Alarm: Beklaut im Paradies?!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht Urlaub auf Pulau Pangkor! Doch plötzlich ertönt ein lauter Schrei! Eine diebische Affenbande hat das Urlaubsdomizil entdeckt! Die Räubermannschaft schnappt sich alles, was nicht niet- und nagelfest ist. (S5 E16)

programme.title: Singapur extrem: Todesstrafe und Rikscha-Wahnsinn!
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich in Singapur mit Tourguide Suzy. Zuerst soll die Metropole auf einer Bootsrundfahrt erkundet werden. Schnell kommt es zu einem äußerst heiklen Thema: Singapurs Gesetze und... die Todesstrafe! (S5 E17)

programme.title: Speedboot-Abzocke auf Barbados?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens verbringen einige Tage auf Barbados, doch statt Ruhe will Robert sofort Action. Beim geplanten Speedboot-Trip läuft vieles anders als erwartet. Seit über zehn Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI ihr Leben zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events. (S6 E02)

programme.title: Überraschung: Robert Geiss kauft heimlich ein Boot!
programme.desc: Es muss ein Boot her! Und das am besten sofort! Robert Geiss weiß auch schon ganz genau, wo er eins bekommt. Also auf zum Bootsladen. Doch Carmen Geiss traut ihren Augen kaum... wieso steht auf einem der Boote bereits Roberts Name? (S6 E03)

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: Model With Skin Issues Made Fun Of
programme.desc: After being cast as an "ugly duckling" due to her vitiligo, Wendy quits a demeaning photoshoot. With her mom's support, she embraces her unique look on social media and becomes a top fashion model.

programme.title: Foreign Exchange Student Is Picked On
programme.desc: After bullying Vietnamese exchange student Thien for his food and accent, Kyle is forced to live with him. By giving Thien a chance, Kyle improves his grades and learns never to judge others.

programme.title: Girl Bullied for Being Wrestler
programme.desc: Riley secretly wrestles while her mother pushes for a traditional life. After her boyfriend issues an ultimatum, she chooses her dream, earns her mother's support, and begins training with a pro.

programme.title: Kung Fu Monk Undercover at School
programme.desc: Shaolin monk Chang visits his workaholic American relatives. Through martial arts and mindfulness, he helps his cousins find confidence and teaches his aunt and uncle that family is more important than work.

programme.title: Teen Sneaks in YouTuber Mansions
programme.desc: To save his family from eviction, Dylan joins a "smash and grab" crew targeting YouTubers. After being double-crossed, he turns himself in, leading to his partners' arrest and a second chance.

programme.title: Teens Cheat MrBeast to Win $5 Million at Beast Games
programme.desc: After losing Dhar Mann's Beast Games tryouts, Dax and Lori sneak onto the real set to compete for $5 million. Their sabotage and rule-breaking get them caught and permanently banned by MrBeast.

programme.title: Girl's ChatGPT Leaked Last Day at School
programme.desc: Forced to wear badges of their GPAs, failing artist Isa and overachiever Brielle team up to replace public shaming with a supportive peer tutoring program.

programme.title: Girl Forced Extreme Diet to Win Comp
programme.desc: After being body-shamed and starved by her ruthless coach, Emma joins a rival team that prioritizes health over winning. Her fueled performance proves that well-being is the true key to success.

programme.title: Student Vandalizes Principal's Car
programme.desc: Adam is framed for vandalizing the principal's car using deepfake technology. He discovers his nerdy classmate William used AI to frame him out of love for Adam's girlfriend, Julia.

programme.title: Teen Shamed for Mom's Mistake
programme.desc: When teacher Rebecca is blamed for a student's DUI crash, her son Marcus faces relentless shaming. He and his girlfriend Sofia uncover a police cover-up, clear her name, and expose the corruption.

programme.title: Mexican Girl Shamed for Bad Spanish
programme.desc: Shamed for her poor Spanish, adopted teen Sofia hides her white parents from her boyfriend's traditional family. When exposed, she embraces her true biological heritage, dumps her boyfriend, and finds pride.

programme.title: Popular Girl Hides Her Depression
programme.desc: Popular Jenna stages her kidnapping to escape the pressure of perfection. Classmate Eli, recognizing her hidden depression from his late sister's tragedy, saves her on a cliff edge just in time.

programme.title: Teen Caught Sneaking into a Party
programme.desc: Peter lies to his crush Ariel to secure a date at a sold-out concert. After giving his tickets away, he poses as the headlining DJ, leading to a viral stage disaster and losing Ariel's trust.

Wenn Wiwills Bruder Maurits bei einem Unfall ums Leben kommt, verwittert Wiwills Beziehung mit seinen Eltern. Nachdem sie sich ihren Kollegen als Transfrau geoutet hat, verliert sie ihren Job und ihre Wohnung. Da bleibt keine andere Wahl: Ab nach Kanada für einen Neuanfang. Wenn die Wohnungssuche anfangs auf nichts hinausläuft, kann Ex-Freund und Ökoterrorist Chris ihr wenigstens vorläufig Unterkunft bieten. Doch einmal angekommen in seiner alternativen Wohnsituation kann Sü sich nur schwierig an ihre neue Umgebung gewöhnen.

programme.title: Brave New Girls
programme.desc: Jenna fliegt mit Vanessa nach Los Angeles zum Casting für einen Actionfilm. Doch auf dem Flug geht ihr Gepäck mit all ihren Outfits für das Vorsprechen verloren. programme.title: Threesome

Die Frage werden die drei rasch beantworten müssen, denn Lorraine, die dominante Mutter von Alice, kommt zu Besuch aus Teneriffa. Was soll man seiner Mutter bloß sagen, wenn diese dein Verlobter nicht leiden kann, aber deinen besten Freund liebt? Während Alice sich mit Lorraine unterhält, entdecken ihre zwei Männer etwas Eigenartiges im Babyzimmer.

programme.desc: Lakshmi Niwas ist ein gefühlvolles Familiendrama, das in einem traditionellen Haushalt spielt, in dem Beziehungen, Werte und Schicksal eng miteinander verbunden sind. Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. programme.title: Italien, meine Liebe
programme.desc: In Città di Castello hat sich Isabella Dalla Ragione einen Traum erfüllt. Sie nennt sich "Obstarchäologin" – und ist eine Art Indiana Jones der Botanik. In ihrem "Garten der verlorenen Bäume" wachsen 400 verschiedene Obstsorten. Sie hat Wunderfeigen entdeckt, die ein halbes Kilo wiegen, "betrunkene Birnen", "blutige Pfirsiche" und "Jesus-Christus-Äpfel" gerettet. Die mittelalterliche Stadt Assisi steht ganz im Zeichen des heiligen Franziskus. Bis heute werden die durch das schwere Erdbeben im Jahr 1997 zerstörten Fresken der Basilika restauriert. Sergio Fusetti, Chef der Restaurierungsarbeiten, öffnet die sonst unzugänglichen Archive. Ein kurzer Raftingausflug führt in die wilde Natur der Valnerina...

programme.title: Bauern in Europa

Ihr Bruder Horatio verwandelt die saure Frucht in Schokolade, Likör und andere Köstlichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit der Genossenschaft „Riviera dei Limoni" arbeiten sie daran, die verfallenen Zitronengärten wieder zum Leben zu erwecken.

programme.title: Detektei Layton
programme.sub-title: Katrielles rätselhafte Fälle – S01E10 – Professor Layton und die mysteriösen Kristalle - Teil 1
programme.desc: Rosa, Professor Laytons Assistentin, hat einen letzten Wunsch. Sie möchte noch einmal im Leben Professor Layton, Katrielles Vater, wiedersehen. Die Ermittlungen führen Katrielle in die Vergangenheit, zu Professor Laytons Partner Luke Triton und zu dem seit Jahrzenten ungelösten Rätsel der uralten Reliktsteine.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E01 – Das im Himmel segelnde Schiff
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1919 gelangt ein Mädchen auf das Segelschiff Norn9, wo Teenager mit besonderen Fähigkeiten als Teil der Organisation “Die Welt” agieren. Sie setzen ihre Fähigkeiten für Frieden und Ordnung auf der Welt ein. Das Mädchen hat ihren Namen vergessen und übernimmt Aufgaben an Bord, um niemandem zur Last zu fallen. Dabei wird sie von Kakeru begleitet und so freunden sich die beiden an.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E02 – Besondere Fähigkeiten
programme.desc: Ein Luftfahrzeug erscheint und attackiert das Schiff. Die Barriere im Inneren wird zerstört und zwei Eindringlingen erlangen den Zutritt. Kakeru und Masamune, die mit Koharu unterwegs waren, bringen diese in Sicherheit, bevor sie aufbrechen um die Situation zu analysieren. Währenddessen wird Mikoto von einem der Eindringlinge konfrontiert. Sie versuchen das Zentrum des Schiffes zu zerstören.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E03 – Der blühende Frühling
programme.desc: Sorata Suzuhara hört während eines Ausfluges in ein Museum im Jahr 2016 eine mysteriöse Melodie und wird in der Zeit zurückversetzt. Er trifft auf ein mysteriöses Mädchen, zu dem er sich auf vertraute Art und Weise hingezogen fühlt. Währenddessen versuchen die Teenager herauszufinden, was es mit dem Angriff der Unbekannten auf sich hatte. Gibt es einen Maulwurf unter ihnen?

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E04 – Serenade des Morgengrauens
programme.desc: Als Akito mit Nanami ein Team bilden soll, drückt dieser seine Missgunst darüber aus. Die internen Verdächtigungen erhärten sich und verschlechtern die Stimmung unter den Besatzungsmitgliedern. Als Akito und Nanami in eine aussichtslose Situation geraten, wird ihr Teamgeist auf die Probe gestellt.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E05 – Der schlummernde Wald
programme.desc: Während eines nächtlichen Bades schütten sich die Mädchen gegenseitig ihr Herz aus. Doch es scheint, dass ihre Sorgen noch von einer weiteren Person mitgehört wurden. So landen sie alle als Märchenprinzessinnen in einer seltsamen Traumwelt. Um dieser zu entkommen, müssen sie sich ihren verborgen gehaltenen Gefühle und Sehnsüchte stellen.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E06 – Die Zahnräder setzen sich in Bewegung
programme.desc: Es scheint, dass alle denselben Traum hatten. Akito und Nanami können ihre Differenzen zunächst ruhen lassen. Kakeru und Koharu bleiben Freunde, wenn auch zutiefst beschämt. Und auch zwischen Mikoto und Sakuya macht sich peinliches Schweigen breit. Masamune treibt währenddessen die Ermittlungen bezüglich des Verräters voran.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E07 – Traum der Realität
programme.desc: Obwohl Sorata weiterhin vor hat eines Tages zurück zu kehren, findet er sich zunächst mit seinem Schicksal ab, auf der Norn9 bleiben zu müssen. Die Explosion hat großen Schaden angerichtet und so muss zur Sicherheit eine Zwischenlandung durchgeführt werden. Der Abschied steht kurz bevor und so wollen die Freunde noch ein paar wenige letzte Erinnerungen gemeinsam erschaffen.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E08 – Die Welt
programme.desc: Heishi versucht Mikoto telepathisch zu erreichen, doch ohne Erfolg. Die einzige Hoffnung besteht darin, dass ihre Barriere weiterhin aktiv ist. Die Freunde begeben sich auf die Suche nach ihr. Währenddessen trifft Mikoto auf Natsuhiko und seinen Partner, die zuvor das Schiff angegriffen hatten und erfährt mehr über deren Motive.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E09 – Die Wahrheit für jeden
programme.desc: Koharu findet schockierende Details über Kakerus Geschichte und seine Motive heraus. Auf der Norn9 erhält Masamune die Information, dass Shiro die Person war, die zuerst die Idee des Resets hatte. Kann die Besatzung auf Hilfe aus der Zukunft hoffen?

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E10 – Aion
programme.desc: Kakeru sucht verzweifelt nach Koharu. Die anderen treffen währenddessen ihre Entscheidungen und warten auf ihre Freunde. Aion lässt verlauten, dass dies der letzte Reset werden würde.

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E11 – Der Reset
programme.desc: Gerade als Sakuya Mikoto zur Hilfe kommt, tritt Natsuhiko auf den Plan. „Die Welt” wird schon bald ihre Entscheidung verkünden. Die Fähigkeiten, Erinnerungen und vielleicht sogar die Leben der Freunde stehen auf dem Spiel. So beschließen sie alle einen bedeutsamen letzten Tag zu verbringen. Doch werden sie sich an die Versprechen überhaupt noch erinnern können, wenn alles vorbei ist?

programme.title: Norn9 – S01E12 – Sorawo und Toriko
programme.desc: Die Aussicht auf eine Zukunft ohne Kakeru bricht Koharu das Herz, was zu einer Störung während des Resets führt. Während die anderen in dem Glauben aufwachen, dass dieser geglückt sei, kommt Masamune hinter die wahren Absichten von Aion.

programme.title: Sword Art Online
programme.desc: In einer Höhle in Richtung der neutralen Stadt Lugru werden die beiden Spieler plötzlich angegriffen. Obwohl die Gegner auf Kiritos starke Angriffe vorbereitet waren, hat der Spriggan doch noch ein Ass im Ärmel.

programme.title: Sword Art Online

programme.title: Sword Art Online

programme.title: Sword Art Online

Wenn er dafür die Stärke erreicht, die er schon so lange anstrebt…

programme.desc: Nachdem Naruto und das Team wieder nach Konoha zurückgekehrt sind, beschäftigt sich Sai intensiv damit, seinen zwischenmenschlichen Beziehungen zu verbessern. Aufgrund Sakuras medizinischer Fähigkeiten, nennt er sie ‚Hexe‘ und ist erstaunt, dass er damit nicht so gut ankommt. Naruto hingegen spricht mit Kakashi, er ist besorgt, da er gegen Sasuke überhaupt keine Chance mehr hat und Kakashi rät ihm trocken, einfach stärker zu werden als Sasuke. Er solle doch sein ganz persönliches, neues Jutsu entwickeln…

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Tsunade entlässt Kakashi aus dem Krankenhaus. Es geht darum, dass lernen soll, die Form und die Eigenschaft seines Chakras zu verändern. Dafür muss er erstmal rausfinden, zu welchem Element sein Chakra überhaupt gehört und Kakashi verzweifelt ein bisschen, weil Naruto sich ziemlich blöd anstellt. programme.title: Boruto

programme.title: Boruto

programme.title: Boruto
programme.desc: Nachdem Kokuri von einem mysteriösen Mann angegriffen wurde, wollen Boruto und Mitsuki besser für seine Sicherheit sorgen. Boruto möchte deshalb in Erfahrung bringen, wie er gegen ihn vorgehen kann – für diese Information muss er jedoch erst einmal einen gefährlichen Test der Willensstärke bestehen.

programme.title: Boruto
programme.desc: Oberaufseher Benga ordnet einen Lockdown des gesamten Gefängnisses an, bis der Dieb der hölzernen Karte – und damit auch Kokuris Angreifer – gefunden wurde. Boruto und Mitsuki kombinieren, dass sich der Täter mit ihnen in einer Zelle befinden muss und machen sich daran, alles zu durchsuchen. Allerdings ist nicht jeder ihrer Mithäftlinge von dem Plan begeistert und so mancher verhält sich äußert verdächtig …

programme.title: Boruto
programme.desc: Boruto und Mitsuki versuchen in Erfahrung zu bringen, wo Kokuri das Geld von der Mujina-Bande verstaut hat. Währenddessen will auch Oberaufseher Benga mehr über Kokuris Geheimnis herausfinden – und schreckt dabei vor Gewalt nicht zurück.

programme.title: Naruto

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Sakura kümmert sich um Sasame, der es anscheinend schlecht geht. Jiraiya interessiert sich natürlich für das Mädchen, das vom Fuuma Clan stammt. Die drei haben den Clan verraten und arbeiten inzwischen für Orochimaru, der ihnen versprochen hat, ihren Clan beim Wiederaufbau zu unterstützen…

programme.title: Der Ruf der Duellgeister (2)

Dem Professor gelingt es ebenfalls in die Welt der Duellgeister überzutreten und er offenbart seine wahre Absicht: Er will die Geisterwelt unter seine eigene Kontrolle bringen, sie beherrschen und für sich nutzen. Doch Leo hilft seiner Schwester die Verbindung zur realen Welt nicht zu verlieren. Können die Zwillinge gemeinsam den Professor besiegen?

programme.title: Auf zur zweiten Runde (1)

Die beiden Duellanten schließen Freundschaft und doch kann nur einer das bevorstehende Turbo-Duell gewinnen …

programme.title: Auf zur zweiten Runde (2)
programme.desc: Das Duell zwischen Yusei und Greiger ist in vollem Gange. Gleich zu Beginn des Zweikampfes hat Greiger sein mächtiges Monster „Fliegende Festung Sky Fire“ aufs Feld gerufen und macht Yusei damit das Duell schwer. Greiger will unbedingt gewinnen, um es Rex Goodwin heimzuzahlen – denn er soll Schuld an der Vernichtung von Greigers Heimatdorf sein …

programme.title: Das Geheimnis der Schwarzen Rose
programme.desc: Im zweiten Halbfinal-Duell treten Commander Koda und Akiza gegeneinander an. Der Commander ist fest entschlossen Akiza zu besiegen, da er vor vielen Jahren eine schwere Niederlage gegen sie hinnehmen musste, weil sie ihre übernatürlichen Kräfte eingesetzt hat. Der Ausgang des Duells ist lange Zeit ungewiss, doch dann zieht Akiza ihre neue Fallenkarte Fluch der Rose …

programme.title: Drache gegen Drache (1)
programme.desc: Yusei beschließt seine Top-Karte Sternenstaubdrache mit ins Duell gegen Akiza zu nehmen. Das Duell zwischen Yusei und Akiza beginnt furios, schnell ist das Spielfeld mit Akizas Pflanzenkarten angefüllt. Und obendrein muss Yusei feststellen, dass Akiza es richtig genießt, ihrem Gegner scheinbar überlegen zu sein. Yusei hat also einiges an Gartenarbeit zu leisten, wenn er das ersehnte Duell mit Jack Atlas erreichen will …

programme.title: Drache gegen Drache (2)
programme.desc: Das letzte Duell vor dem großen Finale des Fortune Cups ist in vollem Gange: Akiza und Yusei liefern sich ein spannendes Match. Es dauert nicht lange, bis beide Kontrahenten ihren Drachen aufs Feld gerufen haben und es so zum ersten Drachenkampf im Fortune Cup kommt. Doch Yusei will Akiza eigentlich gar nicht besiegen, sondern besänftigen. Diese lässt Yusei jedoch nicht an sich heran und attackiert weiter. Mit ihren telekinetischen Kräften sorgt sie für ein gehöriges Chaos im Stadion und Yusei bleibt keine andere Wahl, als das Duell mit allen Mitteln zu Ende zu bringen …

programme.title: Finale, erste Halbzeit
programme.desc: Es ist soweit – nach Yuseis Sieg über Akiza steht das Finale im Fortune Cup unmittelbar bevor. Doch noch bevor das große Duell beginnen kann, fordert Yusei von Rex Goodwin, die Wahrheit über die Auserwählten und den Feuerroten Drachen zu erfahren. Ausgerechnet Jack ist es, der Antwort gibt: Er unterstellt Goodwin, seit langer Zeit hinter den Kulissen die Fäden gezogen zu haben, um ein Aufeinandertreffen aller Auserwählten zu ermöglichen. Jacks Champion-Titel, der Fortune Cup und die Entführung von Yuseis Freunden waren nur Mittel zu diesem einen Zweck.

programme.title: Finale, zweite Halbzeit
programme.desc: Das Große Finale im Fortune Cup hat begonnen. Yusei und Jack duellieren sich um den Champion-Titel und es dauert nicht lange, bis beide ihre Drachen auf dem Feld haben. Neben Jack und Yusei sind auch die anderen Auserwählten im Stadion, die den Feuerroten Drachen herbeirufen können. Auch der bisher unbekannte fünfte Auserwählte ist vor Ort. Durch das Meisterschafts-Duell erscheint der Feuerrote Drache und alle Auserwählten werden in eine Paralleldimension versetzt. Um in die Realität zurückzukehren, müssen Yusei und Jack ihr Duell beenden.

programme.title: Carly Carmine bringt Licht ins Dunkel (1)

Die blonde Reporterin Angela ist besonders aufdringlich und versucht ihre Kollegin Carly ins Abseits zu drängen. Goodwin beteuert, der Kampf sei fair gewesen. Währenddessen überlegen Yusei und seine Freunde, was die Vision zu bedeuten hatte und wer der fünfte Auserwählte sein könnte. Da erscheint ein Herausforderer mit einem leuchtenden Mal auf dem Arm …
