programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Le bal des Demoiselles
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie organisent un speed dating afin de choisir celui qui accompagnera Carly à un bal. Pendant ce temps, Spencer suit un curieux régime.

programme.title: La Pop Star
programme.desc: Carly et ses amis tentent d'aider une ancienne pop star à réaliser la vidéo de son grand retour.

programme.title: Freddy, mon héros
programme.desc: Freddy sauve Carly qui était sur le point de se faire percuter par un camion. Elle tombe alors amoureuse de lui.

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: La séparation
programme.desc: Une dispute remet en question l'amitié entre Carly et Sam. Est-ce là la fin d'iCarly?

programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: L'ANTRE : LE FILM LE PLUS MEURTRIER JAMAIS REALISE
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon et une fille entrent dans la forêt pour creuser un trou en enfer. Considéré comme un film maudit de la fin des années 1970, "Antrum" examine le pouvoir horrifiant de la narration.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: La saison des requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur survie après qu'un grand requin blanc les ai piégés au large.

programme.title: The Thompsons
programme.desc: Après les événements sanglants de The Hamiltons (2006), le secret est dévoilé et la famille dysfonctionnelle de vampires porte désormais le nom de Thompson. En fuite face à la loi, la famille Thompson est dispersée à travers l'Europe, et Francis doit se rendre jusqu'en Angleterre rurale pour chercher de l'aide auprès d'autres membres de son espèce, dans le petit hameau de Ludlow. Mais là-bas, l'ancien clan de vampires des Stuart a ses propres desseins : des plans qui menacent la survie même des Hamilton. Est-ce la fin pour les Thompsons ?

programme.title: Outpost 2 : BLACK SUN : NE PAS DIFFUSER
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 1945, à la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale, et un scientifique allemand du nom de Klausener travaille sur une nouvelle technologie effrayante qui a le pouvoir de créer une armée nazie immortelle.

programme.title: Rufus et le Royaume d'Alyne
programme.desc: Des amis de toujours, Scott et Emily, sont chez la grand-mère de Scott lorsqu'ils découvrent, dans une pièce secrète, une mystérieuse créature nommée Rufus accompagnée du sorcier Abbot. Ils ont pour mission de sauver leur monde magique.

programme.title: La vengeance du petit chaperon rouge
programme.desc: Le petit chaperon rouge, le loup, et la mère-grand dirigent une agence d'espionnage ultra-moderne. Leur prochaine mission: délivrer Hansel et Gretel qui ont été kidnappés par une sorcière maléfique.

programme.title: Halloween Island
programme.desc: Kai, Leilani et Eddie, trois enfants que tout oppose, doivent mettre de côté leurs différences pour sauver Hawaï d'un terrible démon légendaire qu'ils ont réveillé par erreur. Face aux plus grands dangers, les enfants vont comprendre ce que sont le courage, l'amitié et les traditions.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Les Z'intrus
programme.desc: Un ado réalise sa destinée en menant frère, sœur et cousins dans une bataille contre des extraterrestres qui utilisent leur maison de vacances pour planifier une invasion.

programme.title: King of Killers
programme.desc: Marcus Garan, un ancien tueur à gages, souhaite percer le mystère d'un incident. Lorsqu'on lui propose un contrat de 10 millions de dollars pour éliminer le plus grand assassin du monde, Marcus se rend à Tokyo pour rencontrer le client, mais découvre que d'autres tueurs professionnels ont également été invités. Marcus et les autres doivent maintenant affronter cet assassin...

programme.title: Dark Game
programme.desc: Un détective se lance dans une course contre la montre pour arrêter un jeu télévisé sur le dark web, où les captifs sont forcés de s'affronter pour rester en vie.

programme.title: Ultimate Justice
programme.desc: Une bande d'anciens soldats d'élite se reforme quand la famille de l'un d'entre eux est la cible d'une attaque.

programme.title: Gacy
programme.desc: John Wayne Gacy est un citoyen modèle. Il ne rate jamais une occasion d'organiser une fête pour ses amis ou de se déguiser en clown pour amuser les enfants. Mais derrière cette façade trop idéale se cache un monstre. Gacy a tué 30 personnes, dont la plupart sont enterrées autour de sa maison.

programme.title: La femme à cordes
programme.desc: Sébastien, un jeune homme d'une vingtaine d'années, entre dans un petit théâtre sur les conseils d'un inconnu. Gogol l'invite à regarder son show. Ce dernier s'amuse à malmener une femme devant un parterre médusé. Sébastien s'interpose, sans connaître les règles du jeu.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Héros
programme.desc: Maxime a 14 ans. Il vit dans un petit village. Adolescent à la carrure ingrate, il peine à trouver grâce aux yeux d'Astrid, la jeune fille de 15 ans dont il est amoureux. Un matin, le village se réveille avec un immense graffiti sur le mur de l'école primaire. Si l'on ignore qui en est l'auteur, on sait tout de même quelle en est la cause : le maire sortant, unique candidat à sa succession, a enrôlé dans sa liste un militant local du front national. Les autorités ouvrent l'enquête tandis que les jeunes cherchent à connaître l'identité de leur héros. maxime voit là une belle occasion d'attirer l'attention d'Astrid.

programme.title: Tout le monde dit je t'aime
programme.desc: Marion quatorze ans, vient de recevoir un mot d'amour de son copain. Elle demande l'avis de sa meilleure amie, Joséphine. Les deux jeunes filles ne sont pas d'accord quant à l'interprétation du mot “Je t‘aime”.

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Nocturnes
programme.desc: Tes est en train de sortir de l'anorexie. La remontée à la surface est difficile, le corps est déréglé, ne répond plus de la même manière. Remanger, c'est accepter de lâcher prise, de perdre le contrôle. C'est à la fois reprendre des forces et accepter sa vulnérabilité. Mais le jeu en vaut la chandelle.

programme.title: Petit crabe
programme.desc: Jeanne vit au bord de la mer. Elle est jeune mais amère. Elle travaille à la poissonnerie parce qu'il faut bien...par dépit surement. Elvis à sa vie, son bateau. Ça lui suffit. De temps en temps, peut être plus maintenant que Kevin, son meilleur pote, est parti étudier à Lyon, il va voir Jeanne. Elle l'intrigue, le perturbe. Perturbe son monde...

programme.title: Les enfants de la nuit
programme.desc: Printemps 1944, dans un village reculé. Henriette, 20 ans, vit seule avec son grand-père Charles. Sa mère a rejoint le maquis. Henriette vit une histoire d'amour avec Josef, un jeune soldat allemand.

programme.title: Bourgeons
programme.desc: Chaque matin, c'est le rituel : Camille, une dame de quatre-vingts printemps sort de chez elle en trimbalant deux gros arrosoirs pour s'occuper de son jardin de l'autre côté de la rue.

programme.title: Petit astre
programme.desc: Alexis, 9 ans, va prendre le train tout seul pour la première fois. Au même moment, à des milliers de kilomètres, une sonde spatiale s'apprête à se réveiller.

programme.title: Rideau
programme.desc: Tom, comédien, vient de se faire quitter par son amie Angela, comédienne dans la même troupe que lui.Encore très amoureux, il tente de la reconquérir.

programme.title: Le Vent tourne
programme.desc: Un weekend d'été à la campagne. Une toute jeune fille s'éloigne de sa famille et se baigne nue dans la rivière. Elle pose ses vêtements sur une grosse pierre bienveillante. Lorsqu'elle ressort de l'eau, ils ont disparu.

programme.title: Les difficultés de la plaine
programme.desc: Marlène et Bachir travaillent en intérim dans un autodrome. Marlène a commis une petite faute dénoncée par un collègue, elle est mise à pied.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: 6 Below : Miracle On The Mountain
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie, l'aventure de l'athlète Eric LeMarque, qui se perd en snowboard lors d'une puissante tempête. Il a survécu huit jours sans aucune aide, et alors qu'il était en plein sevrage d'une addiction à la drogue.

programme.title: Imagine
programme.desc: Une rock-star vieillissante ne souhaite pas changer ses habitudes de vie, jusqu'à ce que son agent lui fasse ouvrir une lettre gardée secrète pendant 40 ans, écrite de la main de John Lennon, le célèbre membre des Beatles. Suite à cette découverte inattendue, Danny Collins va chercher à redécouvrir sa famille et à trouver l'amour.

programme.title: Gun, Robert Altman Presents
programme.desc: Dans cette série de six épisodes, la vie de plusieurs personnages sans lien entre eux change radicalement lorsqu'ils rencontrent le même pistolet semi-automatique .45 à poignée en perle. Rosanna Arquette, James Gandolfini, Daryl Hannah, Kirstin Dunst, Martin Sheen et Carrie Fisher apparaissent dans cette série.

programme.title: Ma patronne, mon ennemie
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une femme au foyer en difficulté se fait passer pour une acheteuse potentielle afin d'aider son patron à conclure des transactions immobilières, elle découvre que ce dernier est prêt à tout pour conclure une affaire, même au meurtre.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis
programme.desc: Juillet 1945. Le navire américain USS INDIANAPOLIS, commandé par le capitaine McVay (Nicolas Cage), est en mission secrète. Parti livrer des composants de la bombe atomique larguée sur Hiroshima, il est torpillé à son retour par les japonais et sombre dans l'Océan Pacifique.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Un jeune écuyer se lance dans une aventure qui va changer sa vie, lui faire gagner le cœur d'une belle jeune fille et secouer le monde médiéval.

programme.title: Les 3 crimes de West Memphis
programme.desc: En 1993, trois enfants sont retrouvés mort à West Memphis, ville de l'Arkansas. Accusés d'être des satanistes adorateurs de musique Heavy Metal, trois adolescents ont été condamnés l'année suivante à perpétuité pour ce triple meurtre.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Un nouveau venu au lycée (Sean Faris) apprend les arts de combat auprès d'un mentor avisé (Djimon Hounsou) et prouve son talent lors de compétitions d'arts martiaux mixtes clandestins

programme.title: Arnold le magnifique
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger est la star de ce documentaire des 100 jours qui ont précédé le concours M. Olympia en 1975. Cinq fois champion du monde, Schwarzenegger s'oppose à Lou Ferrigno (acteur dans la série télévisée L'Incroyable Hulk), nouveau venu et timide, dans une confrontation aussi mentale que physique. Grace à sa guerre psychologique, son intense détermination, ses dérapages verbaux, et son charme qui a fait de lui une célébrité, « Arnold le magnifique » a changé le monde du bodybuilding et lancé la carrière des deux hommes.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Le radio-astronome Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) croit avoir capté un bruit cosmique qui signale l'intelligence extraterrestre. Sa recherche désespérée de réponses l'amène au Mexique à une centrale nucléaire mystérieuse, où il est arrêté pour le meurtre d'un scientifique. Zane doit échapper prouvant l'invasion extraterrestre dans ce thriller intense de science-fiction.

programme.title: Never Back Down
programme.desc: Un nouveau venu au lycée (Sean Faris) apprend les arts de combat auprès d'un mentor avisé (Djimon Hounsou) et prouve son talent lors de compétitions d'arts martiaux mixtes clandestins

programme.title: Waynes World 2
programme.desc: Ayant acquis le statut de star comme présentateur d'émission de fin de soirée à la télé, Wayne (Mike Myers) est maintenant confronté à cette question qui a hanté l'homme depuis des siècles : y a-t-il une vie après le câble ?

programme.title: La valse des pantins
programme.desc: Un comique méconnu, pour se faire reconnaitre, enlève le présentateur d'un show télévisé et n'accepte de le libérer qu'à la condition de participer à son spectacle.

programme.title: Droit au but
programme.desc: Après être montée dans le mauvais bus alors qu'elle devait aller étudier les sciences marines, Cory se retrouve obligée d'effectuer un semestre d'étude à l'Académie de Football Harold. D'abord réticente vis-à-vis du foot, Cory finit par se prendre au jeu.

programme.title: Biker Boyz
programme.desc: Smoke, le " Roi de Cali " , est le champion de la course invaincu et incontesté. Sa supériorité et son titre sont mis en cause par Kid, un jeune prodige brutal de la course, dans une course ultime pour gagner la survie du plus rapide.

programme.desc: Leïla Bekhti, Antoine Griezmann et Black M : trois parcours inspirants vers le succès.

programme.title: Very Good Girls
programme.desc: Lors de leur premier été après la fin du lycée, deux adolescentes new-yorkaises se promettent de perdre leur virginité. Lorsqu'elles tombent toutes les deux amoureuses du même artiste de street art, l'amitié des deux jeunes filles est mise à rude épreuve pour la première fois.

programme.title: La femme idéale
programme.desc: Une femme aide son meilleur ami d'enfance à paraître juif dans le but de conquérir la femme qui l'aime…

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: Dans cette adaptation du classique de 83, Julie (Jessica Rothe) incarne parfaitement la petite fille parfaite qui voit son univers bouleversé lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse de Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker d'Hollywood !

programme.title: De l'Italie avec Amore
programme.desc: Ariel Moss aperçoit ce qu'elle pense être l'homme de ses rêves dans un restaurant local. Dans sa quête pour le revoir, elle rencontre Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur, qui l'aide à comprendre que le chemin vers son cœur passe peut-être par son estomac.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Piégés
programme.desc: Dans un flashback, Ernesto, un jeune escroc, raconte comment il s'est retrouvé au bord d'un gros coup : une enfance à l'orphelinat, des cambriolages à la volée jusqu'à ce que son complice se fasse arrêter, puis l'apprentissage auprès de Lefty, un escroc vieillissant. Après quelques années de succès, ils sont rejoints par Federico, le meilleur, un véritable artiste. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Pilar, une femme du passé de Federico, refasse surface avec une proposition : arnaquer une véritable poule aux œufs d'or, une escroquerie qui pourrait les mettre à l'abri du besoin. Mais une trahison pourrait bien se préparer. Le flashback terminé, Ernesto saura-t-il tirer son épingle du jeu dans le présent ?

programme.title: La Chanson de l'Éléphant
programme.desc: Un matin, Éric Vincent, un trentenaire sans passé et réticent à l'idée de devenir père, reçoit un appel d'un inconnu lui proposant de récupérer les cendres de son père défunt, qu'il n'a jamais connu.

programme.title: Stalingrad Sniper
programme.desc: Le commandant Yashin est envoyé à Minsk, où il découvre des traces de missiles dans la ville...

programme.title: Nom de Code: Geronimo
programme.desc: Cette saga héroïque raconte l'incursion d'une équipe d'élite anti-terroriste en Irak.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Diablo the Ultimate Race
programme.desc: Kuba essaie de gagner rapidement de l'argent pour aider sa petite sœur très malade.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Executive Protection
programme.desc: Max Webber, ancien des forces spéciales, a consacré sa vie et sa carrière à la protection des autres.

programme.title: Une manucure parfaite
programme.desc: Katya, inventrice originale, s'associe à Ryan, consultant charismatique, pour présenter son invention au salon de la beauté. Entre tensions, ambitions et romance, leur partenariat devient explosif.

programme.title: Le gala de l'amour
programme.desc: Katie, organisatrice d'événements talentueuse, doit gérer le prestigieux Garden Gala de sa mère. Entre un paysagiste difficile et la pression familiale, elle se retrouve plongée dans un inattendu triangle amoureux.

programme.title: Dix Jours pour Changer de Vie
programme.desc: Lassées de leur quotidien, les sœurs Helena et Rachel échangent leurs maisons pour deux semaines. Cette expérience inattendue bouleverse leur carrière, leur vision de la vie… et leurs histoires d'amour.

programme.title: Ace Ventura

Deux tribus, les Wachati et les Wachootoo, vénérant l'animal, se rejettent la responsabilité de sa disparition.

Steve Harvey remarquent que ces femmes sont capables de diriger une petite entreprise, de s'occuper à merveille d'une famille de trois jeunes enfants et ou encore de diriger un groupe communautaire en même temps, mais sont incapables de découvrir ce qui plaît aux hommes. Pour lui, elles ne doivent par chercher conseil auprès d'autres femmes : seul un homme peut leur dire comment séduire un homme et le garder. Cependant, tout ça n'est pas du goût de l'autre moitié des 4 couples...

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.11
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.2
programme.desc: Leaving the collapsed Gwanghae behind, Jeongi escapes home with Taedo's help. While hiding at a tavern, Jeongi overhears a conversation between King Seonjo and Euldam, only to be startled when her eyes meet Gwanghae's. King Seonjo orders Euldam to create ritual vessels to be used for the Jongmyo ancestral rites.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.3
programme.desc: Tormented by the shattered fragments of the sacred jar of King Taejo, Gwanghae seeks out Son Haengsu. Recognizing him, Hwa-ryeong urges Gwanghae to meet Jeongi, and he is stunned to learn that she is Euldam's daughter. When Jeongi falls from her horse and lands in Gwanghae's arms, she panics and struggles in surprise—only for them both to tumble to the ground.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.4
programme.desc: Determined to prove that the sacred jar of King Taejo was deliberately broken, Gangcheon drops the vessel onto the floor. As King Seonjo erupts in fury, Gwanghae steps forward and claims full responsibility for the act. King Seonjo immediately orders Euldam's arrest. In a desperate attempt to save her father, Jeongi strikes the petition drum, proclaiming Euldam's innocence to the court…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.5
programme.desc: Jeongi clings to Euldam, sobbing and begging him not to go, while the wounded Taedo fumes in frustration after seeing an assassin vanish into the darkness. Seeking out Hwa-ryeong, Jeongi travels to the merchant guild, where she comes face to face with Gangcheon. She boldly asks whether he will apologize for humiliating Euldam once she becomes the greatest master potter in Joseon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.6
programme.desc: Jeongi accuses Gwanghae of stealing her jade belt, and as she tries to flee and leave him behind, she is seized once again by Gwanghae. Forced to wander with their wrists bound together, the two soon find themselves in grave danger. As punishment for losing the royal jade belt, Gwanghae is assigned as deputy director under the chief artisan Shinseong. Meanwhile, Jeongi sets out on a journey to enter the Bunwon pottery workshop…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.7
programme.desc: Reunited at last, Jeongi and Taedo recognize each other and share all that has happened. Taedo reluctantly lets Jeongi go as she sets her sights on the Bunwon workshop. Entering the Gongchogun selection exam, Jeongi is arrested and thrown into jail after being accused of attempting to cut down palace trees while searching for firewood. Desperate, she pleads with Gwanghae for help, insisting that she must become a master potter no matter what.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.8
programme.desc: Mistaking it for Gwanghae's test, Jeongi sneaks into the Bunwon storeroom to choose pottery, only to be caught red-handed by Gangcheon. While confined, she finally realizes that the man she believed to be Gwanghae was actually someone else. As Jeongi tearfully confesses all the wrongs she has committed against him, Gwanghae listens with a quiet smile.

programme.title: World's Rarest

In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Bucketlist Africa
programme.desc: Africa: one of the most iconic and diverse continents. It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: Bucketlist Europe
programme.desc: Europe is a densely packed continent, with some 700 million residents living across 50 countries. It's famed for its ancient cities and civilisations, but is sometimes overlooked when it comes to the natural world. But there's no doubt that the continent is a treasure trove of natural beauty, a mosaic of landscapes each filled with their own unique animal communities. If you were planning a bucket list trip of the natural wonders of Europe, you'd only have to ask yourself one question: where would you start?

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Wayag archipelago and its underwater wonders. programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari's Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area's water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. programme.title: Masha's Tales

By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history's most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman's patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. “There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill,” the undertaker remembers. “It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn't quite fit.” Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and finds Indravadhan still on his chair, guarding her room. She then learns from the secretary that Indravadhan was taking care of her throughout the night. Gayatri does not wake up Indravadhan, instead, she decides to prepare the coffee before waking him up. Gayatri then learns that Indravadhan has decided to sell a fort in order to pay the loan. She then decides to help Indravadhan out in any way possible. She takes the responsibility of cleaning the house in order to save the money that would be paid to the servants. In the process she hurts herself and loses consciousness. The doctor too declares that he cannot save Gayatri now. What would Indravadhan do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan takes an unconscious Gayatri to the mosque where a Baba treats her. He asks Indravadhan about his whereabouts. Indravadhan does not reveal to the Baba that he is just a soldier. It is also revealed that Kuwar Singh's son has engaged in a gay relationship with a slave. Kuwar Singh scolds his son and asks him to keep in mind that, Indravadhan is not going to leave his throne. Kuwar Singh then asks his son to plan a baby as soon as possible. Kuwar Singh's son claims that he can do anything but will never plan a baby. What will Kuwar Singh's reaction be when he learns this? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri regains her consciousness and finds that Indravadhan's behavior has changed. Gayatri questions Indravadhan as to why he is doing this. Indravadhan claims that he is the one who has hurt her and it is his responsibility to take care of her. On the other hand, Kuwar's son beats up his wife and claims that he does not want to live with her. While Gayatri and Indravadhan on the other hand, are staying in the former's friend's place where they do not get sufficient food for two people. Indravadhan rejects from having the food and asks Gayatri to eat it alone. How will Gayatri convince Indravadhan to share the food? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan cries before Gayatri and claims that he had forgotten to fulfil the responsibility of a husband. Gayatri consoles Indravadhan by saying that he is a good person and knows how to fulfil the responsibilities as common man and as well as a king. Hearing this, Indravadhan leaves Gayatri and walks away. A confused Gayatri thinks as to what wrong she said to Indravadhan. On the other hand, Swarnlekha confronts Kuwar Singh and Kokila and shows her wounds to them. She tells her in-laws that she is going back to her home and is also going to complain about her husband. What will Kuwar Singh and Kokila do now? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Indravadhan finds Gayatri missing, he decides to search for her. On the other hand, Gayatri is held at gunpoint. She is then tied up to a chair by the baba and the family with whom Indravadhan and Gayatri were staying. Indravadhan too is held by the family and tied up to a wall. Later, Indravadhan questions Gayatri as to why she did not inform him about anything. Gayatri replies to Indravadhan that he was not ready to hear anything from her. On the other hand, Kuwar Singh and Kokila talk about Swarnlekha and her decision. They decide to talk with their son and convince him. While on the other hand, Gayatri and Indravadhan try to set themselves free and escape. Will Indravadhan and Gayatri be able to set themselves free? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Indravadhan and Gayatri return home and they are confronted by Raj Mata. Raj Mata acts as though she does not know what actually had happened in the lives of Indravadhan and Gayatri. After the 'Aarti' the couple are welcomed in the house. Later, Indravadhan finds Gayatri struggling to tie a knot at her back. Indravadhan attends her and ties the knot up for her. On the other hand, Kokila meets Swarnlekha and threatens her. While on the other hand, Gayatri is suspicious as to how could Swarnlekha fall sick? Will Gayatri learn about Swarnlekha's condition? Keep watching to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Raj mata spots a spy in the Raj Mahal and follows her. She fails to catch up as the spy manages to evade Raj Mata. The spy then meets Kuwar Singh and gets some orders from him and meanwhile, Raj Mata informs Gayatri about the spy in the Raj Mahal. Later, Gayatri's brother meets her and invites her for an event being held at his home. When Gayatri's brother invites Raj Mata to the event, she declines the invitation. On hearing this, Indravadhan speaks up saying that he would attend the event. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Ranaji and Gayatri reach her house for the Pooja. When Gayatri asks whether he is still angry or not, Ranaji says that he left his anger outside. Kuwar's spy follows the two of them to keep an eye on them. Later Damyianti thanks Ranaj for accepting Gayatri as his wife and he is then asked to wear a dhoti for the Pooja. When he struggles with draping himself, Gayatri helps him. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek thi Rani to find out more.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri wakes up and realizes that Indravadhan has not yet returned. She decides to ask her mother where Indravadhan has gone. When Indravadhan comes back she confronts him and yells at him. Indravadhan apologizes to Gayatri and says that he failed to realize her importance in his life. He then puts a bangle around Gayatri's wrist and claims that he has given her all the rights as a queen, and as well as a wife. In return, Indravadhan requests Gayatri to forgive him. The next day, events are held at Gayatri's home in which both she and Indravadhan participate. What are the events that Indravadhan and Gayatri participate in? Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani to find out.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: When Gayatri finds that her things are missing from her room she asks Ranaji who moved her things. programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.4

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.5

In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.6
programme.desc: Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.7
programme.desc: Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.8
programme.desc: To use Nokyoung's spirit daughter Wol as a human talisman, she is abducted. As Wol attempts to escape, she receives help from Yangmyung—yet fails to recognize him. Dragged into the palace, Wol is forced to enter Hwon's bedchamber as a shaman meant to absorb misfortune.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Kuonechan is a rising star in Korean R&B circles known for his sweet voice and heartwarming music. After debuting in the music scene with the EP “Repetition” in September 2017 he diligently pursued his career releasing a total of three EPs within a year. He's now actively collaborating with big names in the industry including Baek Yerin Jang Sukhoon Humbert and Fisherman and making his distinctive mark in the industry. This artist recently finished his mandatory military duties and announced a new chapter in his career. In this episode Kuonechan performs his new single “Expression” as well as “Don't be sad” “How Did You” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer ALi! ALi burst into the music scene in 2005 as a guest vocalist for Leessang. Thanks to her unique voice and expressive vocals she mesmerized the public immediately and then she made her debut as a solo artist in 2009 with the album “After The Love Has Gone.” In the competition program “Immortal Songs” she presented her own covers of various masterpieces including “Leopard of Kilimanjaro” and “I Have a Girlfriend” and gained both popular and critical acclaim. In December last year ALi released the remake album “Adolescence” which is composed of the five songs that had a huge influence on her back in her 20's and 30's to share with listeners how she makes the most of the youngest day of her life. In this episode ALi performs “For lovers who hesitate” “Break away” and “Please wait for me” from her latest album as well as “Eraser” and “The way the light.” Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this.
